methodologyNotes: Published self-serve pricing was collected from each provider's own pricing page on the accessed date; 1Password, Bitwarden and Keeper rendered live USD prices that were read directly, while NordPass, Proton Pass, Dashlane, RoboForm and LastPass render prices behind a JavaScript region/term selector or returned 403/404, so their figures were corroborated against dedicated 2026 pricing-review sources. Personal/Premium and Family tiers are flat per-account; business tiers are per-seat with the per-user price recorded in monthlyUsd and noted; quote-only (contact-sales) tiers are recorded with monthlyUsd null. Minutes/calls/overage fields are null throughout because they do not apply to password managers.

vendors.name: 1Password
vendors.provenance: https://1password.com/pricing (official; personal, family and business prices rendered live and were read directly on the accessed date)

plans.name: Individual
plans.notes: 1 user. $2.99/mo billed annually ($3.99/mo on monthly billing). Unlimited passwords/passkeys, autofill, secure sharing, multi-device sync, Watchtower breach alerts.

plans.name: Families
plans.notes: Up to 5 family members (additional members can be added). $4.49/mo billed annually ($5.99/mo monthly). Everything in Individual plus shared vaults, family member management and admin recovery.

plans.name: Teams Starter Pack
plans.notes: Flat $19.95/mo covering up to 10 members. Data sharing, security alerts, role-based permissions, developer tools and support. Fixed-size pack, not per-seat.

plans.name: Business
plans.notes: $7.99 per user/month billed annually. Everything in Teams Starter plus SSO/identity-provider integration, advanced vault sharing controls, Watchtower reporting, and a free family account per user.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Quote-only (contact sales). Adds dedicated account management, custom onboarding/training and enterprise-grade administration.

vendors.name: Bitwarden
vendors.provenance: https://bitwarden.com/pricing/ (official; personal, family, teams and enterprise prices rendered live and were read directly on the accessed date)

plans.name: Free
plans.notes: 1 user. Unlimited passwords/passkeys across unlimited devices, secure sharing with one other user, basic two-step login.

plans.name: Premium
plans.notes: 1 user, billed annually at $19.80/year. Integrated authenticator (TOTP), file attachments, emergency access, vault health/security reports, priority support.

plans.name: Families
plans.notes: Up to 6 users, billed annually at $47.88/year. 6 Premium accounts, unlimited sharing and collections, organization storage.

plans.name: Teams
plans.notes: $4 per user/month billed annually. All Premium features plus credential sharing, event/audit logs, directory sync and SCIM provisioning.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: $6 per user/month billed annually. All Teams features plus granular access policies, passwordless SSO, account recovery, self-hosting and Access Intelligence; includes a free Families plan per user.

vendors.name: Dashlane
vendors.provenance: https://www.dashlane.com/pricing (official; the page renders prices via a JavaScript selector and showed only '--' for amounts, so personal prices are corroborated via security.org and cybernews 2026 pricing reviews; the business pricing page exposes no self-serve dollar amounts)

plans.name: Premium
plans.notes: 1 user, billed annually only (Dashlane discontinued its free tier and monthly billing). Unlimited passwords, cross-device sync, dark web monitoring and a bundled VPN.

plans.name: Friends & Family
plans.notes: Up to 10 members, billed annually. Everything in Premium for each member plus a family dashboard.

plans.name: Business
plans.notes: Quote-only on the official page (Omnix Password Management / Credential Protection list prices as '--' and route to Buy now, Try free or Contact Sales). Adds SSO, SCIM provisioning, admin console and policy controls.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Quote-only (contact sales). Custom deployment, advanced provisioning and dedicated support.

vendors.name: NordPass
vendors.provenance: https://nordpass.com/pricing (official; plan structure and Free tier confirmed on-page, but Premium/Family/business amounts render behind a JavaScript term selector and showed 'Loading', so standard (non-introductory renewal) per-month rates are corroborated via security.org 2026 NordPass pricing review)

plans.name: Free
plans.notes: 1 user. Unlimited passwords with autosave/autofill, but active on only one device at a time.

plans.name: Premium
plans.notes: 1 user. Standard 1-year rate $1.89/mo ($1.59/mo on the 2-year term). Multi-device sync, Password Health, Data Breach Scanner, email masking, file attachments.

plans.name: Family
plans.notes: Up to 6 accounts. Standard 1-year rate $3.69/mo ($2.79/mo on the 2-year term). All Premium features for every member.

plans.name: Teams
plans.notes: $1.99 per user/month on the 1-year term ($1.79 on 2-year), sold as a fixed 10-user pack. Admin panel, secure item sharing, activity log.

plans.name: Business
plans.notes: $3.99 per user/month on the 1-year term ($3.59 on 2-year). Adds SSO, Google Workspace/Entra/Okta provisioning, security dashboard and company-wide policies.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: $5.99 per user/month on the 1-year term ($5.39 on 2-year). Adds dedicated account manager, priority support and advanced provisioning/onboarding.

vendors.name: Keeper Security
vendors.provenance: https://www.keepersecurity.com/personal.html (official; consumer prices confirmed on Keeper's own knowledge base at help.keeper.io/article/158-how-much-is-keeper). Business tier dollar amounts are not displayed on the public pricing page (revealed only at checkout / via sales), so they are recorded as quote-only.

plans.name: Free
plans.notes: 1 user, one mobile device, up to 10 password/passkey records, local identity and payment storage, two-factor authentication.

plans.name: Keeper Unlimited
plans.notes: 1 user, billed annually at $42.99/year (~$3.58/mo). Unlimited passwords/passkeys across unlimited devices, autofill, unlimited secure sharing, cloud backups, emergency access.

plans.name: Keeper Family
plans.notes: Up to 5 private vaults, billed annually at $91.99/year (~$7.67/mo). Everything in Unlimited plus 10 GB encrypted file storage and shared folders with permissions.

plans.name: Business Starter
plans.notes: Per user/month billed annually for 5-10 users; the dollar rate is not published on the pricing page (shown only at checkout). Encrypted vault, admin console, credential sharing, autofill.

plans.name: Business
plans.notes: Per user/month billed annually; the dollar rate is not published on the pricing page. Adds shared team folders, delegated administration, advanced org structure and a free Family Plan per user.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Quote-only (contact sales). Adds advanced provisioning (SCIM, AD/LDAP, SSO/SAML), advanced 2FA, role-based access control and developer APIs.

vendors.name: Proton Pass
vendors.provenance: https://proton.me/pass/pricing (official; Free tier and plan structure confirmed on-page, but paid amounts rendered as $0.00 in the captured HTML, so Pass Plus/Family and business per-seat rates are corroborated via softwarefinder.com and tekpon.com 2026 Proton Pass pricing reviews)

plans.name: Proton Free
plans.notes: 1 user. Unlimited logins, notes and cards across unlimited devices, password generator, passkeys, 10 hide-my-email aliases, password breach alerts.

plans.name: Pass Plus
plans.notes: 1 user, $2.99/mo billed annually (was $4.99 before the March 2026 cut; $1.99/mo on 2-year). Unlimited hide-my-email aliases, integrated 2FA, vault and link sharing, dark web monitoring, custom domains.

plans.name: Pass Family
plans.notes: Up to 6 users, $4.99/mo billed annually ($59.88/year). Everything in Pass Plus for the whole family plus an admin management panel.

plans.name: Pass Essential
plans.notes: $1.99 per user/month billed annually (business); $4.99/user/mo on monthly billing. Org-wide vault sharing, activity log, basic admin controls.

plans.name: Pass Professional
plans.notes: $4.85 per user/month billed annually (business); $6.99/user/mo on monthly billing. Adds SSO, SCIM provisioning and advanced security/admin policies.

vendors.name: RoboForm
vendors.provenance: https://www.roboform.com/pricing (official page returned a 404/region redirect to WebFetch, so personal prices are corroborated via security.org and vpnoverview.com 2026 RoboForm pricing reviews; figures are standard non-promotional annual rates)

plans.name: Free
plans.notes: 1 user, single device. Unlimited logins, password generator, form filling, secure notes (no cross-device sync or cloud backup).

plans.name: Premium
plans.notes: 1 user, billed annually at $29.88/year (~$2.49/mo standard rate). Multi-device sync, cloud backup, secure sharing, 2FA, emergency access.

plans.name: Family
plans.notes: Up to 5 users, billed annually (~$3.98/mo standard rate). Everything in Premium for up to 5 individual accounts.

plans.name: Business
plans.notes: Per-seat business tiers exist with rates that scale by seat count and are not published as a single self-serve figure; recorded as quote-only. Adds admin console, group/role management and provisioning.

vendors.name: LastPass
vendors.provenance: https://www.lastpass.com/pricing (official page returned 403 to WebFetch, so prices are corroborated via itqlick.com and securden.com 2026 LastPass pricing reviews; figures are standard annual-billing rates)

plans.name: Free
plans.notes: 1 user, one device type (computer OR mobile). Unlimited passwords, password generator, secure notes, one-to-one sharing.

plans.name: Premium
plans.notes: 1 user, $3/mo billed annually. Access on all device types, 1-to-many sharing, 1 GB encrypted file storage, dark web monitoring, emergency access.

plans.name: Families
plans.notes: Up to 6 users, $4/mo billed annually. 6 Premium accounts, a family manager dashboard, unlimited shared folders.

plans.name: Teams
plans.notes: $4 per user/month billed annually (up to 50 users). Admin dashboard, shared folders, basic reporting and policies.

plans.name: Business
plans.notes: $7 per user/month billed annually. Adds SSO apps, advanced MFA, 100+ customizable policies, directory integration and a free Families plan per user.
